packageRules.description: The vite-plus toolchain (vp) and its vite-compatible core must move together, in lockstep with the pinned image tag in dagger/src/helpers/constants.ts (VITE_PLUS_IMAGE), the `vp-version` default in .github/actions/setup-toolchain/action.yml, `VP_VERSION` in install.sh, and mise.toml's `viteplus` entry — bump those manually alongside this PR (`vp upgrade <version>` updates the local CLI), then verify with `vp toolchain` and a real `vp run ready`. @vitest/coverage-v8 is included here because it peer-pins `vitest` to an exact version (verified in node_modules — not a range), and vitest itself is bundled internally by vite-plus, not a direct catalog entry.
Storybook packages must stay on matching minor versions.
OpenTelemetry SDK/exporter packages must stay in lockstep.
Commitlint packages must stay on matching versions.
@trpc/client pins @trpc/server to an exact version (verified in node_modules — not a range), so a version mismatch fails install outright, not just at runtime.
unocss and its @unocss/* plugins pin each other to exact matching versions internally (verified: unocss's own @unocss/core dependency and peer ranges are exact, not semver ranges).

@hono/* packages peer-depend on hono; bump them together so pnpm never auto-installs a second, unpinned hono (packages/common declares hono explicitly for @hono/node-server's peer for the same reason).
Grafana Faro packages must stay in lockstep.
